release.message:
# EVEMon 4.0.0
## Breaking changes - EVE API keys are replaced by EVE SSO: add your characters again with File > Add Character. Your characters, plans and settings are kept. - EVEMon now runs on .NET 10 and ships with its own runtime (no .NET install needed). - Dropbox and OneDrive settings sync were removed (Google Drive remains).
## New - All character and corporation data comes from ESI. - Portraits and icons load from the current EVE image server.
